_comment: Variant C — mid-range EMA, wider RSI filter, mid ATR stop. More permissive entries, wider stops.
rationale: Mid-range EMAs sit between A and B in responsiveness. Wider RSI range (30-70) accepts more entries including slightly oversold/overbought conditions — better suited for trending markets where momentum extends further. Larger stop (-3.5%) gives trades more room to breathe but increases max loss per trade. Best candidate for strong trending conditions.
